name: Leucoagaricus gongylophorus

ecology.substrate: leaf fragments cut and tended by ants

notes: Makes swollen food tips for the ants; the lineage has been passed nest to nest for over 23 million years, in a five-way symbiosis with a garden parasite and protective bacteria [34]. The mushroom is rarely seen: ants remove young ones and it fruits after a nest is abandoned [34], so no size is given. Central America and the Caribbean are entered as NA.
